answer: Vouch-slot bond blocks fake farms: a sponsor's bridge is the only way, two slots per epoch, 70 staked per vouch. Each vouch files a public relic, a key-signed first-task record. Each epoch a comet audits one in eight relics; a copied task, shared key or fake relic burns the bond, bars the sponsor. 1,000 fakes need 500 sponsors at 115: 115,000 vs 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond. Rented sponsors fail: one bad vouch bars them.
